cases.answer: The SOS election exact lookup layer indexes selected Missouri Secretary of State official election-return PDFs. It currently covers 3 official statewide election-return PDF(s): 2024 General Election; 2024 Primary Election; 2022 General Election. It also covers selected 2024 county/turnout PDF(s): 2024 General Election county results; 2024 General Election voter turnout. The parser extracted 782 contests and 1,604 statewide candidate/ballot row(s), 1,404 selected county candidate row(s), and 117 voter-turnout row(s). It can answer selected statewide winner, candidate vote, percentage, total-vote, primary party-winner, county winner/vote, and county turnout questions. It does not include voter files or precinct-level files.
